executive_summary: Build failed during test compilation with 90 errors across multiple test classes. The primary root cause is a mismatch between DTO field types (enum vs String) and missing/changed method signatures in response DTOs. Tests expect String types for TaskStatus and TaskPriority but the actual DTOs use enum types. Additionally, several setter/getter methods are missing from response DTOs (PagedTaskResponse, BulkTaskResponse, TaskResponse).

errors.message: Multiple test methods fail: incompatible types - TaskStatus/TaskPriority enums cannot be converted to String (26 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Test code attempts to pass TaskStatus and TaskPriority enum values where String parameters are expected. The DTO classes were refactored to use enum types, but test mocks still use String types.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all TaskControllerTest mock setups to use TaskStatus.name() and TaskPriority.name() when String values are required, or change the DTO setters to accept enum types directly.

errors.message: Multiple test methods fail: cannot find methods setPage, setLast, setVersion, setSuccessCount, setFailureCount, setErrors (12 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Response DTO classes (PagedTaskResponse, BulkTaskResponse, TaskResponse) were refactored to use builder pattern or immutable fields, removing public setter methods that tests depend on.
errors.fix_recommendation: Refactor test code to use builder pattern for constructing response DTOs, or add @Setter annotations to response DTO classes if mutable setters are required.

errors.message: Method getUserTasks signature mismatch: required (Long, Pageable) but found (Long, int, int, String)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks method signature was changed to accept Pageable object instead of individual pagination parameters (page, size, sort).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test calls to getUserTasks to construct and pass a Pageable object using PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sortField)) instead of passing individual parameters.

errors.message: Multiple test methods fail: incompatible ErrorResponse types between exceptions package and dtos package (11 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse class exists in both com.myproject.exceptions and com.myproject.models.dtos packages. Tests expect dtos.ErrorResponse but GlobalExceptionHandler returns exceptions.ErrorResponse.
errors.fix_recommendation: Consolidate ErrorResponse into a single package (preferably models.dtos) and update GlobalExceptionHandler to return the unified ErrorResponse type. Remove duplicate ErrorResponse class.

errors.message: Cannot find methods handleConcurrentCreation and handlePerformanceThreshold in GlobalExceptionHandler
errors.root_cause: Exception handler methods for ConcurrentTaskCreationException and PerformanceThresholdExceededException were removed or renamed in GlobalExceptionHandler.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @ExceptionHandler methods for ConcurrentTaskCreationException and PerformanceThresholdExceededException in GlobalExceptionHandler, or remove the corresponding test methods if these exceptions are no longer used.

errors.message: Multiple test methods fail: same issues as TaskControllerTest - enum/String mismatch, missing getters, getUserTasks signature mismatch (35 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Service layer tests have identical issues to controller tests: enum type mismatches, missing DTO methods, and getUserTasks signature changes.
errors.fix_recommendation: Apply the same fixes as TaskControllerTest: use enum.name() for String conversions, use builder pattern for DTOs, and update getUserTasks calls to use Pageable objects.

summary: 6 grouped error categories found affecting 90 individual compilation errors
